code.text: DTR documentation requirement: DentaQuest prior authorization questionnaire (D3320, D2950, D2740)

description: DentaQuest requires the completed prior authorization questionnaire, clinical notes documenting medical necessity and radiographs before it will decide the request.

note.text: Documentation-requirement Task from the DTR step. It is distinct from the single referral coordination Task (task-referral). It is closed when the prior authorization is decided (narrative: 'DTR Task closed'), here at the ClaimResponse time.
